properties.name: Venous BG
properties.definition: Venous BG is measured as part of further investigations to assess blood glucose levels.

properties.name: U&E and FBC
properties.definition: U&E and FBC are part of the further investigations to assess electrolytes and full blood count.

properties.name: Blood Cultures
properties.definition: Blood cultures are performed to identify potential infectious causes of diabetic ketoacidosis.

properties.name: ECG
properties.definition: ECG is performed to assess cardiac status, especially if potassium is abnormal or there are concerns about cardiac function.

properties.name: CXR
properties.definition: CXR is performed to assess for pulmonary causes, especially if oxygen saturation is low.

properties.name: MSU
properties.definition: MSU is performed to assess for urinary tract infection as a potential precipitating cause.
